comparison: 1. total STAT3 RPPA vs STAT3 mRNA
label: EXPLORATORY_POSTHOC
can_establish: Protein-mRNA agreement for ONE gene across two independent assays. Typical TCGA protein-mRNA r is modest (~0.4-0.5 for well-behaved antibodies), so a value in that range is consistent with a working platform and a value near zero would indict the total-STAT3 antibody in that cohort. NO threshold is prespecified; this is descriptive.
note: EXPLORATORY, POST-HOC. Back-transformed pooled Fisher z (random effects, REML); Wald interval quoted, as in 13. tanh of a pooled z is not an unbiased mean of the per-cohort r. The four comparisons are NOT on equal evidential footing -- see can_establish.

comparison: 3. total STAT3 RPPA vs STAT3_pY705 RPPA
label: EXPLORATORY_POSTHOC
can_establish: WITHIN-PLATFORM: both antibodies are measured on the SAME lysate, the same array, and are normalised together. It is NOT independent evidence that either antibody is valid -- shared loading and normalisation inflate it. A high value is uninformative about assay validity; a LOW value would be surprising and would suggest one antibody is noise.
